metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the strap, the coffer, Egeon, six-and-twenty shillings, and bed at nine.

yesterday: Tomorrow, after the bells, is the time you have been saving for the letter.
The strap is still long. The coffer is still twenty pound fifteen shillings.
You played Egeon at two, the third time this week.
The share is six-and-twenty shillings, the first since July, and it stayed in the purse. Monday at two is The Shrew.
You went to bed at nine.
